proof: If $d=\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$ on a domain of size $n$, every shattered set has size at most $d$.  Thus $|\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)|\le\sum_{i=0}^{d}\binom ni\le(en/d)^d$.  Taking logarithms gives $d=\Omega(\log\operatorname{sh}(\mathcal H)/\log n)$, with the small-$n$ cases absorbed in the universal constant.
name: VC Dimension / Log Shattering
